title: Team organisation concentration
description: Per governance team: how many members resolve to an employer, how many distinct employers they span, the largest employer and its share, and the concentration (HHI, 10000 = one employer). 'single employer' = one employer holds every resolved seat — a capture / bus-factor risk, most serious for admin, release, security, and maintainer teams; teams with more unmapped than resolved members are never flagged. 'unknown' is how many members aren't in the affiliations map (mostly non-maintainers), so read a flag on a mostly-unknown team with caution. Most concentrated first.

columns.label: members
columns.description: The total number of members in the team.

columns.label: resolved
columns.description: The number of members whose employer has been resolved.

columns.label: distinct orgs
columns.description: The number of distinct organisations the members are affiliated with.

columns.label: largest org
columns.description: The organisation with the most members in the team.

columns.label: largest org %
columns.description: The percentage of members in the team belonging to the largest organisation.

columns.label: HHI
columns.description: The Herfindahl-Hirschman Index for organisation concentration.

columns.label: unknown
columns.description: The number of members whose employer could not be determined.

columns.label: single employer
columns.description: The number of teams where one employer holds all resolved seats.

columns.label: organisation mix
columns.description: A list of organisations with mapped members in the team.
